headline: 90 jobs available at Ashuganj Power Station: Online applications open November 2
summary: Ashuganj Power Station Company Ltd. (APSCL) has announced a new recruitment drive for 90 positions across 15 different roles. Candidates with qualifications ranging from SSC to postgraduate degrees are eligible to apply online.
details: Ashuganj Power Station Company Ltd. (APSCL), an entity owned by the Bangladesh Power Development Board, has issued a new recruitment circular. The company aims to hire a total of 90 employees for 15 distinct positions.

The available positions include Assistant Engineer (Electrical, Mechanical, Procurement, Chemical, Health, Safety & Environment, Finance/Accounts/Internal Audit, HR & Administration) and Sub-Assistant Engineer (Electrical, Mechanical).

Further roles include Junior Assistant (Finance/Accounts/Internal Audit, Computer Operator), Fireman, and Security Guard. Educational requirements vary from SSC or equivalent to graduate and postgraduate degrees in relevant fields.

Applicants must meet specific CGPA criteria, generally a minimum of 2.50 on a 4.00 scale or 3.50 on a 5.00 scale (or 2nd division). The maximum age for general candidates is 32 years, with relaxations for departmental candidates (up to 40) and retired military/law enforcement personnel (up to 42 for Security Guard).

Successful candidates will receive a basic salary along with various benefits, including house rent/accommodation, two festival bonuses, New Year bonus, education allowance, medical allowance, and a power station allowance. The initial contract is for three years, including a one-year probationary period, with a retirement age of 60.
Application fees, ranging from BDT 56 to BDT 223 depending on the position, must be paid via SMS using a Teletalk prepaid SIM. Detailed instructions are available on the application portal.

Interested candidates can apply online through the Teletalk website or APSCL's official website. The online application process commenced on November 2, and the deadline for submission is November 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM.

headline_marked: [[HSC result re-evaluation applications begin]] today, Nov 1; apply online by Nov 7
headline: HSC result re-evaluation applications begin today, Nov 1; apply online by Nov 7
summary: Following the recent HSC and equivalent exam results, nearly 600,000 students failed. Those dissatisfied with their scores can now apply for re-evaluation online.
details: Students dissatisfied with their HSC and equivalent exam results, published yesterday, can apply for re-evaluation starting today, November 1, 2026. The application process will continue until November 7.
The Bangladesh Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee has announced detailed rules for the online application process and fee payment. No manual applications will be accepted.
To apply, students must visit the designated website, enter their roll and registration numbers, select their board from a dropdown list, and click 'Submit'.
Afterward, a mobile number must be provided to receive SMS notifications when re-evaluation results are published. The next screen will display the student's subject-wise results.

To apply for re-evaluation for one or more subjects, select the relevant subjects and click 'Pay Fee'. A fee of BDT 150 is required for each paper, and for subjects with two papers, applications must be made for both.
Fees can be paid through bKash, Nagad, DBBL Rocket, Upay, and Sonali Seba. Detailed payment steps are available by clicking the 'Pay' button on the portal.

After paying the fee, enter the application portal and click 'Submit'. If additional subjects need to be added after an application is submitted, the same method can be used without re-entering the mobile number.

Before fee payment, selected subjects can be withdrawn by clicking 'Delete' to modify the application, and new subjects can be chosen. However, once the fee is submitted, applied subjects cannot be cancelled, and no refunds will be issued under any circumstances.
